sentences.text:
Rup Atanu Roy vs The State Of West Bengal & Anr on 8 May,
2025
Item 08.05.

In The High Court At Calcutta
 No. 2025 Criminal Revisional Jurisdiction
 09 Appellate Side
Ct 22 Crr 4819 of 2024

rup Atanu Roy
 Vs.
 The State of West Bengal & Anr.
 Mr. Arijit Chatterjee,
 Ms. Sharmistha Dhar,
 Ms. Pronita Naskar. ... for the petitioner.

1.
This revisional application has been filed with a prayer for quashing of the proceeding in connection
with Dum Dum Police Station Case No. 790 of 2022 dated 24.11.2022 under Section 341/ 342/ 323/
498A/ 406/ 34 &506 of the Indian Penal Code, pending before the Court of Learned Additional
Chief Judicial Magistrate, Barrackpore, North 24 Parganas.

entities.text:
Additional
Chief Judicial Magistrate, Barrackpore, North 24 Parganas
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2.  Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioners has submitted that a complaint was lodged with all false allegations and decree has already been passed in divorce suit under Section 13 of the Hindu Marriage Act.
3. In that view of the matter, learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner has prayed for admission of this revisional application.
4. Having heard the learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioners as well as having gone through the documents annexed with the revisional application, the same stands admitted.

5. Petitioner is directed to serve notice upon the State through the office of the Public Prosecutor of this Court and also to serve notice upon the opposite party No.2 through speed post with A/D and to file affidavit of service on the returnable date.

6. Let the matter appear in the Combined Monthly List of June, 2025 under the heading "Contested Application".
7. Liberty is given to the petitioner to file application for stay as and when required.
(Bibhas Ranjan De, J.)
